title: Smoke Valley Dub
prompt: aphex twin. Energy: mid groove, swung. Register focus: chord-led dub. Palette: RolandTR808 kit + dub chord stabs. Tempo: 118 BPM. Arc shape: two peaks with a valley. Mood modifier: smoky, dubby, late-night.
description: A smoky, late-night dub roller: swung 808 kicks and shuffling hats carry off-beat chord stabs that delay out into the dark. The progression drifts through four dorian chords across two heated peaks separated by a hushed, spacious valley.
